title: rcp.Message
description: RCP canonical message type (spec §15.5) — a decoded ACF_ABB/ACF_GBB request, response, or acknowledge.

byte_bus_id.description: Addresses a single Endpoint on an RC Server, scoped to the enclosing stream_id.

transaction_num.description: Correlates a request with its eventual response, scoped to the enclosing stream. Omitted from JSON when zero.

control.description: Request-descriptor control bits: Ack=0x80, Read=0x40, Write=0x20, Response=0x10, Error=0x08, MoreSegments=0x04.

read_size_or_segment.description: Read size (no MoreSegments) or segment number. Omitted from JSON when zero.

timestamp.description: Meaningful only for the ACF_GBB (timestamped) encoding. Omitted from JSON when zero.

body.description: Request/response payload bytes, base64-encoded. Omitted from JSON when empty.
